payload.body: Codex custom prompts (~/.codex/prompts, home-only, flat) are deprecated upstream in favor of codex SKILLS, which support repo-level sharing. The current prompts shim target works on codex-cli 0.145.0; a codex-skills install target would restore repo-travelling shims (the preferred model). Revisit when skills-based discovery stabilizes — backlog item gewxrd52.
